title: Bhavanetti
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Bhavanetti bhavanettīnirodho ti bhante vuccati || katamā nu kho bhante bhavanettī katamo bhavanettīnirodho ti || || [page 191] XXIII. 5. 5] VAGGO PATHAMO 191 4 Rūpe kho Rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ya upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusāyā || ayaṃ vuccati bhavanettī tesaṃ nirodhā bhavanettīnirodho || || 5-7 Vedanāya || || Saññāya || || Saṅkhāresu || || 8 Viññāne yo chando || pa || adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā || ayaṃ vuccati bhavanettī tesaṃ nirodhā bhavanettīnirodho ti || ||
